name: com.yevhenii.purser
description: Drop-in in-app purchases for Unity, verified by your self-hosted Purser server on SpacetimeDB: Google Play and App Store through Unity IAP 5, Amazon Appstore, Steam, Stripe and Xsolla. Server-side validation, consume/acknowledge, restore, entitlements, paywalls.

samples.description: Minimal shop: buy, restore and show entitlements (IMGUI, no extra dependencies).
Bridge from AmazonStoreAdapter to Amazon's Appstore SDK Unity plugin (Unity IAP 5 has no Amazon store).
Bridge from SteamStoreAdapter to Steamworks.NET (MicroTxnAuthorizationResponse_t, SteamID, language).
